analysis:
This batch is documentation only: a changelog entry, an index link, addon-hold.md and an inference.md troubleshooting row. The docs describe add-on hold hardening under TB-012/A-018/T-059.

Claims made by the docs:
- A load fence (addonHoldLoadRefusal in ensureModelLoaded, loadNemotronSuperSlot and requireNativeMiMoPublication) refuses new loads and stops running loads before install with a 503. The hold reports held only once the load gate is free (addon-hold.md head 90-93, 106, 120).
- The drain-timeout cancellation is scoped to requests found still running and stops on release (head 94-96, 105).
- persistLoadedModelSet does not rewrite loaded-models.json while any hold is active (head 70-74).
- The socket verifies the peer signer before taking one of 8 slots, with a 10 s request-line deadline (changelog 11-13; addon-hold head 87-89, 110).
- The hold record and mailbox files are read non-blocking and FIFOs or links are refused (head 109; changelog 14-15).

If implemented as written, these narrow T-059 DoS vectors: an unsigned local process starving slots, and a FIFO stalling the provider. They also prevent models loading beside VMs.

No Swift source was supplied in this batch. A doc-only change cannot introduce a regression, and no finding is made.

Integration must verify against the source:
1. The pre-slot signer check happens at accept time, before any read, and cannot be raced. It must keep the same-UID plus hardened-runtime requirement and the identifier-equals-signer binding (AddonIPCServer.swift, AddonPeerPolicy.swift).
2. The FIFO/link refusal uses O_NONBLOCK|O_NOFOLLOW plus an fstat regular-file check (AddonHoldStore.swift, AddonHoldControl.swift).
3. The load-fence checks cover every install path.
4. The unbounded wait for an unwinding load cannot wedge the hold or the shutdown/stop preemption.
5. Cancellation scoping does not leave untracked tasks.

The new security/local-control.md is referenced but not in this batch. The threat model's TB-012/T-059 may need an update for the pre-slot verification and the 10 s deadline.
